text:
marta: Quick heads-up — during the q-onboard runs earlier today we started seeing labeler SLA misses and a growing sampling backlog. Can we triage?
priya: How big is the backlog? Any specific cohorts?
labeler-bot: queue-summary: total_pending=1,842; golden_pending=312; non_golden_pending=1,530; avg_wait=2h12m; sla_miss_rate=12% :warning:
ashwin: The backlog looks concentrated on shortprefix/text-similar buckets — dedupe is rejecting a lot and then re-routing which is burning cycles. Seen this when kv-prefix cache gets warm.
samir: Is this correlated with the new quant build? We started routing q-int4 canaries to the same sampler yesterday.
ashwin: Possible. The quantized variant increases token churn for some prompts (more edits), which trips our fuzzyhash threshold. More false positives -> requeue -> labeler thrash.
june: Proposal: pause non-golden labeling for 4h, prioritize golden re-evals for the q-int4 canary cohort and run a targeted backfill with limited concurrency. That should free capacity for urgent regressions. Thoughts?
priya: +1 on prioritizing golden. Also can we add an "uncertain" tag option so labelers can triage instead of bouncing tasks? That reduces requeues.
marta: Agree on both. @ashwin can you run a quick sample query to produce the candidate list so we can hand it to labeling? Need counts per cohort and avg token_length.
ashwin: Running quick SQL now:```SELECT cohort, count(*) AS n, avg(char_length(prompt)) AS avg_len FROM samplebank WHERE model_tag IN ('q-int4-canary','hosted-canary') AND status='pending' GROUP BY cohort;```
labeler-bot: query-result: q-int4-canary: 1,120 (avg_len=412); hosted-canary: 430 (avg_len=398)
samir: Ok that's actionable. Suggest the backfill batch be: prioritize cohorts where avg_len < 600 and golden flag=true, limit concurrency to 40 workers, run for 4 hours starting 02:00 UTC. If SLA_miss_rate stays > 20% after 2 hours, escalate to eng-infra.
june: I'll schedule the backfill and update the labeling-ops runbook. Also adding a short playbook for labelers: if scoring uncertainty > 0.6 mark as `uncertain` and skip.
priya: Can we also snapshot the golden set outputs before we re-run? Need to compare pre/post quantized outputs for regression hunting.
marta: Yes — snapshot and stash under `gs://redwood-curation/snapshots/1781234567/q-int4-pre` then we'll run the eval harness. I'll open a canary job for differential metrics.
ashwin: Command to kickoff relabel job (for ops):```./tools/labeler_ctl start --cohort q-int4-canary --mode golden-priority --concurrency 40 --duration 4h --tag backfill-1781234567```
labeler-bot: job-started: id=98765, cohort=q-int4-canary, concurrency=40, owner=june
samir: Reminder: run the quick eval comparing top-1 disagreement rate between hosted and q-int4 on the golden snapshot. If disagreement > 8% we block the rollout.
priya: Noted. I'll prepare the eval promptset and golden diff scripts.
marta: Thanks everyone. I'll loop in @ops if we hit the 20% SLA threshold. Otherwise let's reconvene after the 4h window and review the snapshot diffs + labeler notes. :thumbsup:
labeler-bot: update: 20m in — pending=1,102, golden_pending=298, sla_miss_rate=10.8%
